mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have 67 degree temperatures with overcast skies at Firemans Park. The moon is currently in its first quarter phase. Also, look up at 7:37 PM tonight to see the International Space Station, which will be visible for five minutes as it passes from the Cross Plains area in the northwest toward the Madison area in the northeast, staying low near the horizon.

City news this afternoon highlights that the Verona Police Department is currently hiring for patrol officer positions. They are seeking service-minded individuals for their community-oriented team. Additionally, the city has recently adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan to guide long-term growth and development.

There is plenty to do this week. Today, you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness or head to Hop Haus Brewing for trivia. Tomorrow, enjoy live music at Baileys Run Vineyard or the Wisconsin Brewing Company, and look forward to the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival starting this Friday.

Looking at recent police activity, on September 5, an officer discovered multiple vehicles in the area of Main and Jefferson streets with slices of cheese on their windshields, an incident that appears to be part of a viral social media trend.
Culvers of Verona is currently open until 10 PM today, though please note that the store is currently closed for a remodel, so there is no flavor of the day available.
